opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: up to £56,000 in year one, £28,000 in years two and three

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must not yet have held a full‑time permanent academic post in a UK university, must hold a doctorate, and be resident in the UK. Must be early‑career researchers.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable work. Up to 145 fellowships available in 2027.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers with a UK university post, resident in the UK, and who have been prevented by routine duties from completing a research programme.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for experienced researchers to complete a piece of original research. Maximum award £70,000, tenable 3–24 months.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities or eligible UK independent research institutes. Applicants must be employed by the institution.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative research projects covering staff costs and research expenses.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK academic staff (or specialist arts institutions) must coordinate the visit; host institution must have research degree awarding powers.
opportunities.summary: Funding for UK institutions to invite eminent overseas scholars for visits lasting 3–12 months.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with a permanent UK university appointment, at least two years post‑PhD experience.
opportunities.summary: Awards to support early‑career scholars to build a research team and undertake ambitious projects.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in humanities and social sciences, UK university post, resident in the UK.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for distinguished researchers to complete a major piece of original research. Awards up to £70,000, tenable 2–3 years.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million each

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree awarding powers (or consortia of up to two universities).
opportunities.summary: Centenary Doctoral Scholarships to fund up to 30 interdisciplinary doctoral programmes, plus additional scholarships for under‑represented groups and post‑doctoral opportunities.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired UK university staff (or eligible independent research organisations) who have retired by the start of the fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Fellowships for retired researchers to complete a research project. Awards £3,000–£24,000, tenable 3–24 months, start between August 2027 and July 2028.
